label: late copy phase (last outputs), strongest in short sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase. Essentially silent in the original phase, at <DEL>, and on the first two copy outputs (recall_idx 0-1). It is concentrated on the last one or two copy steps (to_go <= 1 holds 85% of activation mass). Short sequences (L=3,4) account for about 61% of mass, and there it fires reliably from recall_idx 2 on (precision 0.79). The largest activations are on the final step of L=3 sequences, especially when the echoed input is o or r. For L=5-7 it fires on only ~20% of the last two steps, and more often when the echoed input token is one of o,r,w,c,2,0,d,a. For L=8-9 it is weak and rare. Token-identity modulation is only partly captured, so recall and precision are incomplete. Simplest alternative: (phase==2)&(L<=4)&(recall_idx>=2) gives P 0.79, mass recall 0.61 on dev.
